title: The Closet That Saved Her Life
hook: She heard the tornado before the sirens ever started.

segments.narration: At 9:17 p.m., Maya was washing dishes when the kitchen window started breathing in and out like it was alive. The power snapped off, and every phone in the house screamed at once.
Her husband was still driving home, so Maya grabbed their six-year-old and ran to the hallway closet. She pulled coats over their heads and held the doorknob shut with both hands.
Then the roof lifted. Not cracked, not shook, lifted. The whole house roared like a freight train had parked inside the walls.
For thirty seconds, she could not tell if they were on the floor or floating. Her daughter kept whispering the alphabet, because Maya told her letters could keep time.
When it went quiet, the closet was the only room still standing. The rest of the house was scattered across the street, but both of them walked out without a scratch.
